taxes.gap2_note: not a tax: the self-employed join Social Security only by choice: Social Security (Self-Employed Persons) Regulations reg. 3 (3) 'Participation shall be on a voluntary basis but once registered, the self-employed person shall contribute on a sustainable basis to the Social Security Fund' and reg. 4 (d) (insured only if he 'has opted to join the Social Security Scheme'; the contribution, reg. 11, is 7 % of the declared weekly income, $55-$320). The National Health Insurance contributions of the self-employed exist only if the Board levies them by regulations (Cap. 44 s. 71 (1) 'may be required ... by regulations', s. 74 (2) (a) 'if levied'); no such regulations are among the subsidiary legislation of Cap. 44 (sub/44/1-18) or the statutory instruments of 2020-2026 in the repository. Interpretative Guide §11 and §42: voluntary contributions are not taxes and are excluded from heading 2000.
